title: Mongolian alphabets, pronunciation and language
notable_features: Writing direction: left to right in vertical columns running from top to bottom.
Used to write: Alasha, Barin, Buryat, Chakhar, Evenki, Jarud, Khamnigan Mongol, Khorchin, Mongolian
The letters have a number of different shapes, the choice of which depends on the position of a letter in a word and which letter follows it.
The Mongolian script is traditionally taught as syllables rather than individual letters.
